source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    CUSTKEY,
    NAME,
    ADDRESS,
    NATIONKEY,
    PHONE,
    ACCTBAL,
    MKTSEGMENT,
    COMMENT,
    CASE
        WHEN ACCTBAL > 10000 THEN 'High Value'
        WHEN ACCTBAL BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value'
        ELSE 'Low Value'
    END AS CUSTOMER_SEGMENT,
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM STG.CUSTOMER_reddy;

SELECT
    ORDERKEY,
    PARTKEY,
    SUPPKEY,
    LINENUMBER,
    QUANTITY,
    EXTENDEDPRICE,
    DISCOUNT,
    TAX,
    RETURNFLAG,
    LINESTATUS,
    SHIPDATE,
    COMMITDATE,
    RECEIPTDATE,
    SHIPINSTRUCT,
    SHIPMODE,
    COMMENT,
    EXTENDEDPRICE * 0.1 AS PROFIT, -- Assuming a 10% profit margin
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM STG.LINEITEM_reddy

SELECT
    N.NATIONKEY,
    N.NAME,
    R.REGIONKEY,
    R.NAME  AS REGION_NAME,
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM
    STG.NATION_reddy N
JOIN
   STG.REGION_reddy R ON N.REGIONKEY = R.REGIONKEY;

scripts.text:
CREATE VIEW RPT.CUSTOMER_TOP_10_PURCHASE AS


WITH CustomerTotalPurchase AS (
    SELECT
        CUSTKEY,
        SUM(totalprice) AS total_purchase_amount
    FROM ODS.ORDERS_reddy
    GROUP BY CUSTKEY
)
SELECT TOP 10
    CUSTKEY,
    total_purchase_amount
FROM CustomerTotalPurchase
ORDER BY total_purchase_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CUSTKEY,
    NAME,
    ADDRESS,
    NATIONKEY,
    PHONE,
    ACCTBAL,
    MKTSEGMENT,
    COMMENT,
    CASE
        WHEN ACCTBAL > 10000 THEN 'High Value'
        WHEN ACCTBAL BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value'
        ELSE 'Low Value'
    END AS CUSTOMER_SEGMENT,
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM STG.CUSTOMER_kayal;

SELECT
    ORDERKEY,
    CUSTKEY,
    ORDERSTATUS,
    TOTALPRICE,
    ORDERDATE,
    ORDERPRIORITY,
    CLERK,
    SHIPPRIORITY,
    COMMENT,
    TOTALPRICE * 0.1 AS ORDER_PROFIT, -- Assuming 10% profit margin
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM STG.ORDERS_kayal;

SELECT
    PARTKEY,
    NAME,
    MFGR,
    BRAND,
    TYPE,
    SIZE,
    CONTAINER,
    RETAILPRICE,
    COMMENT,
   
    0.1 AS PROFIT_MARGIN, -- Assuming a 10% profit margin
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM STG.PART_kayal;

SELECT
    SUPPKEY,
    NAME,
    ADDRESS,
    NATIONKEY,
    PHONE,
    ACCTBAL,
    COMMENT,
    CASE
        WHEN ACCTBAL > 10000 THEN 5  -- High Rating
        WHEN ACCTBAL BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 3  -- Medium Rating
        ELSE 1  -- Low Rating
    END AS SUPPLIER_RATING,
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM STG.SUPPLIER_kayal;

SELECT
    ORDERKEY,
    PARTKEY,
    SUPPKEY,
    LINENUMBER,
    QUANTITY,
    EXTENDEDPRICE,
    DISCOUNT,
    TAX,
    RETURNFLAG,
    LINESTATUS,
    SHIPDATE,
    COMMITDATE,
    RECEIPTDATE,
    SHIPINSTRUCT,
    SHIPMODE,
    COMMENT,
    EXTENDEDPRICE * 0.1 AS PROFIT, -- Assuming a 10% profit margin
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM STG.LINEITEM_kayal

SELECT
    N.NATIONKEY,
    N.NAME,
    R.REGIONKEY,
    R.NAME  AS REGION_NAME,
    GETDATE() AS INSERT_DATE
FROM
    STG.NATION N
JOIN
   STG.REGION R ON N.REGIONKEY = R.REGIONKEY;
